title: Song Familiarity
description: EEG recordings from twenty-nine participants who listened to song melodies and responded as soon as a song felt familiar. Participants then tried to identify the song (title, artist, or lyrics) and chose the title from a four-option multiple choice display, receiving visual feedback on correctness. The dataset includes synchronized audio reconstructions of what each participant heard, supporting research on music familiarity and recognition.
methods_description: Participants listened to song melodies and indicated when a song felt familiar, then attempted to identify it and selected a title from four options with correct/incorrect visual feedback. Song stimuli were taken from Kostic and Cleary (2009). Audio reconstructions of each participant's experience were synchronized with the EEG recording.
